manifest.description: The corpus manifest; relative to the configuration file.

FillerConfig.description:
One filler entry under `[fillers.<name>]`: a command with placeholders or an HTTP endpoint,
the rendering profile it takes, the paste mode its result is composited with, a timeout,
and for the lab a revision string. `key_env` names the environment variable holding a
bearer key, which is read at call time and never stored, logged or journaled.

command.description:
The command and its arguments; `{image}`, `{mask}`, `{out}` and `{prompt}` are
substituted. Exactly one of `command` and `url`.

key_env.description: The environment variable holding the bearer key for `url`.

max_side.description: The filler's largest side; the heal graph windows to it. Unset: no window.

paste.description: The paste mode for its result: `feather`, `hard` or `poisson`.

profile.description:
The rendering profile the filler takes: `grey` or `binary` (mask input), `alpha` or
`tinted` (image input).

revision.description: Free text the lab hashes into a cell's identity; required for lab use.

send_mask.description: For an image-input profile: also send the `grey` rendering as `mask`.

timeout_s.description: Seconds before the call is abandoned as an operational error.

url.description:
The endpoint of a multipart POST (`image`, `mask` when the profile has one, `prompt`
when given) that answers with a PNG.

WorkspaceConfig.description: Where runs keep their workspace when `--workspace` is not given.

dir.description: A directory; relative to the configuration file.
